subject: Follow-up: Technical deep-dive & infra alignment (AsterHealth)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@asterhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Technical deep-dive & infra alignment (AsterHealth)

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal we heard: validate inference economics for AsterHealth's patient-portal summaries, ensure latency <= 350ms p50, and verify private deployment options for PHI.
- Key constraints: onboarding window in Q3, must pass SOC 2 + network review, and want to avoid major code changes on your side.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra team to go over: model sizing & cost, latency profiling, KV cache strategy, and deployment topology (VPC / on-prem options).

Please pick one of these windows (all in ET):
- Wed Jun 23, 10:00–11:30 AM ET (90m)
- Thu Jun 24, 1:00–2:00 PM ET (60m)
- Mon Jun 28, 11:00–12:30 PM ET (90m)

If none work, send two times that fit your calendar and I’ll coordinate. Attendees we plan to bring: Monica (Solutions Eng), Jonas (ML Infra), and me. If you want additional folks from our side (security/ops), let us know.

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a draft agenda for the deep-dive to help prep.

Agenda highlights (draft):
- 5m quick intro & outcomes
- 25–35m workload profile & perf targets (token sizes, QPS)
- 25–35m serving topology & cost levers (batching, quantization, caching)
- 15–25m security/network integration & next steps

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Rafael
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: asterhealth-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today's discovery), redwood-tdx-agenda.md (draft agenda)

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@asterhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@asterhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Technical deep-dive & infra alignment (AsterHealth)

Thanks Rafael — helpful recap.

We'd like to include our infra/ML lead (Chris) and our security contact on the call. Our preference is Wed Jun 23, 10:00–11:30 AM ET — that gives us 90 minutes to cover the integration surface and run through a few performance scenarios.

Couple of asks for the session: 
- Please include an example topology for a VPC-hosted private deployment and an estimate for token-costs at 50 QPS.
- Can your team bring a short list of quantized model options you recommend and any known accuracy tradeoffs?
- We will want to review SOC 2 artifacts / evidence as part of pre-reads — can you share the relevant links or a contact?

I see the draft agenda you attached — that looks good. I’ll coordinate with Security to add them to the invite.

Marta
Director of Engineering, AsterHealth
marta.lopez@asterhealth.com

Great, Wed Jun 23 10–11:30 AM ET is open for our team. We'll plan to run 90 minutes and cover the items you called out.

- Prep materials: I uploaded a 1-pager on our batching/kv-cache approach and a short matrix of quantization profiles to the drive link I added to the thread.

I will send a calendar invite with video dial-in and attach the pre-reads (drive link + SOC 2 summary).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jonas Weber
